hemomancy.acolyte.about_clarity.line1.about: the Acolyte, a gentle parishioner, explaining that clarity comes after purity: first the infection is quieted, then the player learns to see without fever clouding it

hemomancy.acolyte.about_clarity.line2.about: the Acolyte, a gentle parishioner, hedging that consecrated copper teaches endurance, as it was explained to them: it changed, oxidized, then settled and stayed

hemomancy.acolyte.about_clarity.line3.about: the Acolyte, a gentle parishioner, saying that once the player's blood is fully pale, the copper's lesson can stop being a wound and become a halo

hemomancy.acolyte.absolved.line1.about: the Acolyte, a gentle parishioner, telling an Absolved player that most of the old red blood has gone pale, and that mourning it is all right and common

hemomancy.acolyte.absolved.line2.about: the Acolyte, a gentle parishioner, urging the player to let grief run out through clean water, leaving something that is truly theirs rather than the blood's

hemomancy.acolyte.clarity.line1.about: the Acolyte, a gentle parishioner, telling a player who has taken the second water that quiet blood makes the world louder, and asking if it feels like too much some days

hemomancy.acolyte.clarity.line2.about: the Acolyte, a gentle parishioner, warning that sharp sight can still lie and a clear eye can turn merciless without noticing

hemomancy.acolyte.cleansing.line1.about: the Acolyte, a gentle parishioner, telling a Cleansing player they are in the long middle, where blood has learned fear and frightened things hold on harder

hemomancy.acolyte.cleansing.line2.about: the Acolyte, a gentle parishioner, explaining that the Rite of the Silver Veil lays a temporary ward, and that walking it means leaving the closing wound alone

hemomancy.acolyte.corrupted.line1.about: the Acolyte, a gentle parishioner, telling a Corrupted player that the first dose opened a painful wound because the blood-memory is less sure of itself now

hemomancy.acolyte.corrupted.line2.about: the Acolyte, a gentle parishioner, warning that the old crimson current still answers if called, and each call teaches it the player's name again

hemomancy.acolyte.enlightened.line1.about: narration of the Acolyte bowing until their forehead nearly touches their clasped hands before an Enlightened player

hemomancy.acolyte.enlightened.line2.about: the Acolyte, a gentle parishioner, admitting they can't tell whether the Lady weeps for joy or as a warning, and that among the Unstained it is the same water

hemomancy.acolyte.how_clarity.line1.about: the Acolyte, a gentle parishioner, explaining that consecrated copper at the podium readies the player, the Rite of Clarity Ascension wakes it, and clarity deepens through offerings that teach perceiving rather than hungering

hemomancy.acolyte.how_clarity.line2.about: the Acolyte, a gentle parishioner, listing silver chalices, hemolytic plating and the verdigris rites as aids that strengthen the halo purity made room for

hemomancy.acolyte.how_purify.line1.about: the Acolyte, a gentle parishioner, explaining that purity grows through restraint, mercy and offerings that ask nothing of blood, as they understand it

hemomancy.acolyte.how_purify.line2.about: the Acolyte, a gentle parishioner, explaining that hemolytic solution at the podium readies the player, Lethean Baptism begins purity, and then come Lethean flowers, pale dew, sleep, clean labor and tended animals

hemomancy.acolyte.how_purify.line3.about: the Acolyte, a gentle parishioner, begging the player not to rush, because closing a wound too fast leaves rot under the skin

hemomancy.acolyte.lady_lore.line1.about: the Acolyte, a gentle parishioner, describing Our Lady of Still Waters as living wherever a fever breaks, belonging to this world in the cold water rather than a heaven

hemomancy.acolyte.lady_lore.line2.about: the Acolyte, a gentle parishioner, saying that when the crimson fungus spread through blood and memory, the world fought it as a body fights infection, and that they believe that part

hemomancy.acolyte.lady_lore.line3.about: the Acolyte, a gentle parishioner, describing the Lady as that answer with a face, patient and defensive rather than cruel, with someone in the stillness they can't name

hemomancy.acolyte.not_on_path.line1.about: narration of the Acolyte lowering their voice as the church air cools around a player not yet on the path

hemomancy.acolyte.not_on_path.line2.about: the Acolyte, a gentle parishioner, telling a player who hasn't started the washing that a Zealot can talk through troubling blood, after which they would bring hemolytic solution to the podium

hemomancy.acolyte.purified.line1.about: the Acolyte, a gentle parishioner, telling the player their blood is now white like winter bone and the first transformation has set for good

hemomancy.acolyte.purified.line2.about: the Acolyte, a gentle parishioner, explaining that for clarity the player brings consecrated copper to the podium, walks the Rite of Clarity Ascension, and lets the last crimson habit go quiet, with no hurry

hemomancy.acolyte.silver_veil.line1.about: the Acolyte, a gentle parishioner, describing the Silver Veil as purification's inner skin that holds the crimson current away from the player

hemomancy.acolyte.silver_veil.line2.about: the Acolyte, a gentle parishioner, saying that once there is distance from the crimson current, the player can make their own choice

hemomancy.acolyte.tainted.line1.about: the Acolyte, a gentle parishioner, telling a Tainted player the stain is thinning, they may feel hollow where power used to answer, and hoping they are sleeping

hemomancy.acolyte.tainted.line2.about: the Acolyte, a gentle parishioner, offering the thought that the hollow is room the player is getting back

hemomancy.acolyte.verdigris.line1.about: the Acolyte, a gentle parishioner, explaining that verdigris is what copper becomes after long exposure, changed but still useful, and that they like that

hemomancy.acolyte.verdigris.line2.about: the Acolyte, a gentle parishioner, saying nobody reaches purity untouched, not even the longest-standing members, and that one arrives by honestly surviving the contact

hemomancy.acolyte.who_are_you.line1.about: the Acolyte, a gentle parishioner, answering that they keep the still water, mostly sitting with people and witnessing what the infection does before anyone judges

hemomancy.acolyte.who_are_you.line2.about: the Acolyte, a gentle parishioner, saying some of them were Harbingers or had Harbingers in the family, a few came for the people, and all know it is easier to inherit the crimson than shed it

hemomancy.annetta.cowering.unstained_hin.about: Annetta, a frightened woman cowering, telling a player from the still waters that they know why she can no longer pray cleanly
Annetta saying she will drink anything to make the noise stop and is exhausted from being proof

hemomancy.clarity.awakened.about: the name of the Awakened clarity stage of the Unstained path, shown as a stage label

hemomancy.clarity.discerning.about: the name of the Discerning clarity stage of the Unstained path, shown as a stage label

hemomancy.clarity.enlightened.about: the name of the Enlightened clarity stage of the Unstained path, shown as a stage label

hemomancy.clarity.vigilant.about: the name of the Vigilant clarity stage of the Unstained path, shown as a stage label

asking the Acolyte to tell about Our Lady
asking the Acolyte what the Silver Veil is
asking the Acolyte to tell about verdigris

hemomancy.dialogue.acolyte.option.how_cl.about: asking the Acolyte how to awaken clarity

hemomancy.dialogue.acolyte.option.how_pu.about: asking the Acolyte how to purify oneself

hemomancy.dialogue.acolyte.option.task_c.about: offering the Acolyte a silver chalice as an observance task
offering to help the Acolyte consecrate the church as an observance task

hemomancy.dialogue.acolyte.option.task_g.about: offering to gather Ghost Pipe for the Acolyte as an observance task

hemomancy.dialogue.acolyte.option.task_h.about: offering to bring hemolytic solution to the Acolyte as an observance task

hemomancy.dialogue.acolyte.option.task_w.about: offering the Acolyte a poppy wreath as an observance task

hemomancy.dialogue.acolyte.option.vow_ga.about: vowing to gather the remedies the church asks for

hemomancy.dialogue.acolyte.option.vow_ge.about: reporting that the player has completed the Gentle Separation vow

hemomancy.dialogue.acolyte.option.who_ar.about: asking the Acolyte who they are

hemomancy.dialogue.action.confirm.about: a hint telling the player to review what a dialogue choice will do and continue when ready

hemomancy.dialogue.event.accept_church.about: narration of the Zealot nodding and telling the player to follow the silver bells, which will lead them to the church

hemomancy.dialogue.event.accept_purifica.about: narration of the Zealot's eyes brightening as they tell the player to bring hemolytic solution to the podium and begin

hemomancy.dialogue.event.gives_stained_c.about: narration of a stained route being set down for the player, who recognizes the marked church before ever seeing it

hemomancy.dialogue.event.reject_help.about: narration of the Zealot watching the player turn away help, silver eyes dimming

hemomancy.dialogue.event.relay_chart_car.about: a system message that the player already carries a Relay Chart

hemomancy.dialogue.event.relay_chart_iss.about: a system message that the Voyager draws the player a Relay Chart

hemomancy.dialogue.event.scout_gives_not.about: narration of the Scout pressing a small water-stained journal into the player's hands, her grip loosening almost at once

hemomancy.dialogue.event.unstained_start.about: a system message that the Zealot already gave the player their entry supplies and that anything in the church chest is shared with other visitors
a system message that the Zealot supplies the missing entry kit: two Hemolytic Solutions and the Liber Immaculatus, one solution for the Podium and one for making Cleansed Stone

hemomancy.dialogue.guardian.option.ask_a.about: telling the Guardian the player has a question about something they found

hemomancy.dialogue.guardian.option.leave.about: acknowledging the Guardian and ending the conversation

hemomancy.dialogue.guardian.option.repla.about: asking the Guardian for a replacement Absolution Dagger

hemomancy.dialogue.guardian.option.task_.about: promising to ring the Pale Watch bell as an observance task
promising to plate the quiet watch with hemolytic plating as an observance task

hemomancy.dialogue.guardian.option.vow_s.about: reporting that the player sheltered another person from the stain

hemomancy.dialogue.guardian.replace_abso.about: the Guardian agreeing to replace a lost Absolution Dagger and stating the cost: two Pale Silver Ingots and one Cleansed Blood Crystal Shard, for pledged hands only

hemomancy.dialogue.memo.make_note.about: a bracketed prompt inviting the player to make a note of what was just said before it fades

hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.acolyte.the_l.about: asking the Acolyte whether they have ever felt Our Lady near
the Acolyte, a gentle parishioner, confessing they felt the Lady once by the water at dawn when sleepless, unsure if it was peace or tiredness
the Acolyte, a gentle parishioner, saying they told nobody because it felt private, and asking the player to keep it between them
a short teaser hinting the Acolyte hasn't told the others something

hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.acolyte.the_p.about: asking the Acolyte whether they like it at the church
the Acolyte, a gentle parishioner, admitting they came for the soup and stayed for the people who make it, not sure they believe all of it, and asking how the player is holding up
a short teaser noting the Acolyte talks easily but not yet about themself

hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.guardian.the_.about: asking the Guardian where they learned to fight
the Guardian answering tersely that they learned on the line and nowhere else, strike to stop and then stop
a short teaser saying the Guardian doesn't talk to strangers
asking the Guardian why they hold the line
the Guardian saying someone once stood in the line for them and took a blow they had earned
the Guardian saying they owe that person and can't repay them, so they hold the line instead
a short teaser saying that trading with the Guardian long enough may reveal why they hold

hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.scout.anyone_.about: asking the dying Scout whether there is anyone the player should tell
the dying Scout naming her sister at the Church, who mends the robes
the dying Scout asking the player to tell her sister she finished and that it mattered, but not to mention the cold
a short teaser saying the Scout would only say some things to someone she trusts

hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.scout.why_sco.about: asking the Scout why she came down here alone
the Scout explaining she volunteered because nobody else would, the Church needed eyes below, and she is quiet and patient
a short teaser saying the Scout is still writing and may talk if given paper

hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.zealot.the_on.about: asking the Zealot whether they have lost anyone to the stain
the Zealot revealing their brother told them it was only curiosity and they believed him a year too long
the Zealot explaining that when they ask the player why they are here, they ask the question they never asked their brother
a short teaser saying the Zealot only gives some answers to people who have earned them

hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.zealot.why_ch.about: asking the Zealot what brought them to the Church
the Zealot recalling a fever that wouldn't break and a woman who sat with them, who asked what they wanted cured, and asking the player if they know their answer
a short teaser saying the Zealot asks the questions but might answer one after long trade

hemomancy.dialogue.reward_not_delivered.about: a system message that no reward was delivered, advising the player to check the requirements or reopen the conversation near the speaker

hemomancy.dialogue.scout.option.go_in_pe.about: a bracketed action of the player taking the notes and stepping away from the Scout

hemomancy.dialogue.scout.option.leave.about: the player's silent response of an ellipsis, leaving the dying Scout

hemomancy.dialogue.scout.option.take_not.about: accepting the Scout's notes and promising they will be used

hemomancy.dialogue.scout.option.what_did.about: asking the Scout what she noticed about the creatures

hemomancy.dialogue.scout.option.what_hap.about: asking the Scout what happened to her

hemomancy.dialogue.unstained.observance..about: an Unstained speaker telling the player they already carry this observance, that their book shows what remains, and to return when the offering is ready
an Unstained speaker offering to enter an observance in the player's book with its offering and reward, only if the player means to finish it
an Unstained speaker saying the work is done and asking for the offering so the observance can be marked fulfilled

hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.about_a.about: asking the Zealot about the Altar of Cleansing

hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.about_c.about: asking the Zealot what the Rite of Clarity is

hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.about_s.about: asking the Zealot about Silver Ward

hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.about_v.about: asking the Zealot what verdigris means

hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.accept_.about: asking to join the Zealot's church

hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.ask_abo.about: asking the Zealot what became of Annetta
telling the Zealot the player has a question about something they found

hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.how_cra.about: asking the Zealot how to make hemolytic solution

hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.leave.about: a bracketed choice to leave the conversation with the Zealot

hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.not_int.about: declining the Zealot's cause as of no interest

hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.take_st.about: accepting the stained map and promising to go carefully

hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.take_vo.about: asking to take the church's vows of clean service

hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.task_pa.about: promising to bear a Pallid Icon as an observance task

hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.task_st.about: promising to gather the Still Waters as an observance task

hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.tell_me.about: asking the Zealot to tell more about the Unstained path

hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.vow_cle.about: reporting that the player has completed the clean labor vow

hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.vow_sti.about: reporting that the player has gathered the Still Waters for the vow

hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.reject_respons.about: the Zealot answering a player who refused the cause, warning that every rite drives the stain deeper and asking what the player thinks they are buying

hemomancy.drudge.memory_unsupported.about: a system message that this memory cannot be installed in a Drudge

hemomancy.guardian.ambient.line1.about: narration of the Guardian holding still and meeting the player's eyes, then curtly telling them to stand their ground and keep their hands clean

hemomancy.guardian.item_hint.about: the Guardian curtly telling the player to pick an item from their pack and they will say whether it belongs in the field

hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.absoluti.about: the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, naming the Absolution Dagger, issued to every pledged Unstained at Clarity Ascension, for last resort, mercy and self-defense
the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, noting hemolytic treatment is built in so a temporary coating shouldn't be wasted on it

hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.bow.line.about: the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, describing a bow as keeping blood at a distance, good for that alone
the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, telling the player to shoot plain arrows and keep the quiver full

hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.crossbow.about: the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, describing a crossbow as hard-hitting at range with a slow reload, which is its price
the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, telling the player to pick their shot before the line closes

hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.golden_a.about: the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, describing a golden apple as a concentrated restorative, not the Church's, which works, and admitting having eaten one when field medicine ran out
the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, telling the player to carry proper Unstained field medicine, keeping the apple for when badly hurt with no options

hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.hemolyti.about: the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, describing hemolytic plating as four solutions cured into one sheet that disrupts blood-magic on contact and lines gear for afflicted ground
the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, explaining raw solution breaks down on cloth or plain metal, plating holds the compound for good, and Unstained armor and shields need it
the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, describing hemolytic solution as breaking down blood-matrix corruption, carried for treatment and for gear that takes it
the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, noting the Absolution Dagger doesn't need it because its treatment is permanent
the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, describing a hemolytic vial as solution in brittle glass, thrown to shatter and purge blood-taint
the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, telling the player to know the target before spending the dose

hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.iron_che.about: the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, describing plain iron armor as stopping ordinary blows but doing nothing against infection
the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, telling the player to maintain it until proper Unstained armor is ready

hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.iron_swo.about: the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, saying a blade works but arm's length is dangerous near infectious blood
the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, telling the player to keep distance and discipline, and apply a sanctioned treatment if the weapon takes one

hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.lethean_.about: the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, describing Lethean brew as pale distillate run through the Pallid Retort, stronger than dew and accepted by the Altar of Cleansing as an offering
the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, warning to be careful: dew takes the chosen manipulation, brew takes every one the player knows, so do not spill it
the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, describing Lethean Dew as bottled water in a Stillwater Condenser with Ghost Pipe nearby, not gathered off a holy dawn
the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, telling the player to carry it sealed, the first rule of field medicine being not to contaminate the medicine
the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, describing Lethean Poppies as said to bloom where Our Lady walked, so finding one means she was there first
the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, telling the player to mark where they grow, since Zealots upstream need to know where clean ground is

hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.liber_im.about: the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, saying the Liber records the path, that every Guardian swears to understand it and many walked it
the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, telling the player to read its First Steps and then approach the Podium

hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.minecraf.about: the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, calling ordinary arms serviceable and telling the player to keep them clean, keep reach, and open blood only with cause
the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, saying that against active infection distance and restraint count, not decoration

hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.pale_dis.about: the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, describing pale distillate as Lethean Dew with a Lethean Poppy, or Ghost Pipe through the Pallid Retort, feeding pale silver and brew
the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, saying it isn't needed in a fight, Zealots ask for it, so carry it when they do and otherwise leave it to ritual work

hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.pale_sil.about: the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, describing the Pale Silver Bell: one chime puts Silver Ward on the player and weakens nearby hostiles
the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, telling the player to ring it once and mean it, since panic tells the line nothing
the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, describing Pale Silver as Consecrated Copper and pale distillate, with no ore to mine and iron no substitute
the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, telling the player to guard it because every ingot is somebody's finished ritual work

hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.pallid_i.about: the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, describing the Pallid Icon as a consecrated copy of the river relic, not the original, carried as the Church's emblem
the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, saying it calls up a brief apparition, so ask what is needed and then keep watch

hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.shield.l.about: the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, describing a shield as stopping force with nothing special against blood
the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, telling the player to keep it between the wound and their face

hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.silthmer.about: the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, describing the Silthmere Glaive as sanctioned for its reach, with the edge mattering less, keeping infectious blood away from the hands
the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, telling the player to hold the line and give the wound room

hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.sporitic.about: the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, identifying a sporitic thurible as Harbinger work, fungal support smoke paid for in blood
the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, telling the player to keep it off a clean line since its fumes serve the fungus, not the Unstained

hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.unknown.about: the Guardian brushing off an unfamiliar item as not their work and telling the player to ask someone else

hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.unstaine.about: the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, describing Unstained armor as fieldwear for anyone standing close to active corruption
the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, telling the player to keep every seal sound because color doesn't make gear clean, the wearer does
the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, describing Unstained guardwork as built for a clean defensive line
the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, telling the player to raise it early and let it do its job

hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.warhamme.about: the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, describing the hammer as hard-hitting and keeping the wound closed, which is why Guardians reach for it first
the Guardian, a terse Unstained warrior, telling the player to strike to stop and save what they came to contain

hemomancy.scout.farewell.line1.about: narration of the Scout whispering "good", exhaling, closing her eyes as the hand holding the journal goes still

hemomancy.scout.observation_hint.line1.about: the dying Unstained Scout, saying the insects act as they do outside, hunting, pushing at walls, circling each other, but never took her for anything: not a threat, not prey, nothing

hemomancy.scout.observation_hint.line2.about: the dying Unstained Scout, explaining that at the church the Tooth Pecks wouldn't leave Annetta alone because they seek active infection, so every ward failed, and they hunted something she never knew she carried

hemomancy.scout.observation_hint.line3.about: the dying Unstained Scout, urging the player to think what that means for Annetta, and to use the notes if they can

hemomancy.scout.root.line1.about: narration of an Unstained woman slumped against the bone-speckled geode wall, robes filthy with stone dust, looking up glassy-eyed but focused

hemomancy.scout.root.line2.about: the dying Unstained Scout, weakly greeting the player as someone who found her, saying cold and hunger are finishing her, and begging them to take her notes before she dies

hemomancy.scout.root.line3.about: the dying Unstained Scout, pleading that her work not be wasted

hemomancy.scout.take_notes.prompt.about: the dying Unstained Scout, telling the player to give their hands and take the journal now while she still can

hemomancy.scout.what_happened.line1.about: the dying Unstained Scout, explaining the Church sent scouts to learn what the creatures are, eat and whether they can be reasoned with, she took notes for a day, then the exit collapsed and she never found it again

hemomancy.scout.what_happened.line2.about: the dying Unstained Scout, saying the bugs never touched her in three days, looked right through her, she wrote it all down, doesn't know what it means but knows it matters

hemomancy.trade.acolyte.bread.line.about: the Acolyte asking for six loaves to feed most of the congregation after service, and offering a little dew set aside in return

hemomancy.trade.acolyte.bread.title.about: a short title for the Acolyte's bread trade card

hemomancy.trade.acolyte.refuse_harbinger.about: the Acolyte apologetically refusing to trade with a Harbinger by their own choice, saying the player knows why and they dislike saying it

hemomancy.trade.acolyte.stained.about: the Acolyte apologetically declining an item with blood worked into it because they couldn't bring it into the church

hemomancy.trade.acolyte.thanks.about: the Acolyte sincerely thanking the player, saying small things keep them going

hemomancy.trade.acolyte.wool.line.about: the Acolyte asking for four wool for the cold pews and offering garden poppies in return

hemomancy.trade.acolyte.wool.title.about: a short title for the Acolyte's wool trade card

hemomancy.trade.done.about: a short label saying the trade is done

hemomancy.trade.done_fine.about: a short label saying the trade is done and the item's quality was noticed

hemomancy.trade.grade.fair.about: a short label for the fair quality grade of a traded item

hemomancy.trade.grade.fine.about: a short label for the fine quality grade of a traded item

hemomancy.trade.grade.poor.about: a short label for the poor quality grade of a traded item

hemomancy.trade.guardian.appraise.poor.about: the Guardian dismissing a ruined item and telling the player to keep it

hemomancy.trade.guardian.arrows.line.about: the Guardian stating a trade for sixteen clean arrows

hemomancy.trade.guardian.arrows.title.about: a short title for the Guardian's arrows trade card

hemomancy.trade.guardian.iron.line.about: the Guardian stating they want six iron, for the hammers

hemomancy.trade.guardian.iron.title.about: a short title for the Guardian's iron trade card

hemomancy.trade.guardian.refuse_harbinge.about: the Guardian flatly refusing to trade with a Harbinger and telling them to walk on

hemomancy.trade.guardian.silthmere_glaiv.about: the Guardian offering a Silthmere Glaive for four pale silver and telling the player not to shame it
a short title for the Guardian's Silthmere Glaive trade card

hemomancy.trade.guardian.stained.about: the Guardian refusing blood-work and telling the player to take it back

hemomancy.trade.guardian.thanks.about: the Guardian curtly accepting a trade and sending the player on

hemomancy.trade.guardian.thanks_fine.about: the Guardian curtly approving a well-kept item

hemomancy.trade.guardian.worn_armour.lin.about: the Guardian saying they accept iron or mail armor, worn is fine but not ruined

hemomancy.trade.guardian.worn_armour.tit.about: a short title for the Guardian's worn armor trade card

hemomancy.trade.locked.act.spectacle.about: a short locked-trade label stating a requirement to watch a performance through first

hemomancy.trade.locked.advancement.about: a short locked-trade label stating a requirement of an advancement not yet earned

hemomancy.trade.locked.blood.about: a short locked-trade label stating a requirement of active blood

hemomancy.trade.locked.degree.about: a short locked-trade label stating a requirement of a higher degree

hemomancy.trade.locked.path.about: a short locked-trade label stating a note that the trade is not on the player's path

hemomancy.trade.locked.rapport.about: a short locked-trade label stating a requirement of more rapport

hemomancy.trade.locked.stage.about: a short locked-trade label stating a requirement of a later Unstained stage

hemomancy.trade.refused.blood.about: a short trade-refusal message saying the player lacks enough blood above their reserve

hemomancy.trade.refused.missing.about: a short trade-refusal message saying the player lacks the proper resources to barter

hemomancy.trade.refused.no_room.about: a short trade-refusal message saying the player has no room in their pack for the goods

hemomancy.trade.refused.not_today.about: a short trade-refusal message saying that want isn't on the board today

hemomancy.trade.refused.poor.about: a short trade-refusal message saying the offered item is too poor to accept

hemomancy.trade.refused.sold_out.about: a short trade-refusal message saying nothing is left until the restock

hemomancy.trade.refused.stained.about: a short trade-refusal message saying the speaker won't take outpost goods

hemomancy.trade.refused.unknown.about: a short trade-refusal message saying there is nothing to trade here

hemomancy.trade.scout.paper.line.about: the Scout asking for paper because she is still writing, offering her dew since she won't need it

hemomancy.trade.scout.paper.title.about: a short title for the Scout's paper trade card

hemomancy.trade.scout.refuse_harbinger.about: the Scout refusing a Harbinger, saying they carry the stain and she won't, even now

hemomancy.trade.scout.stained.about: the Scout refusing blood-work in clipped words

hemomancy.trade.scout.thanks.about: the Scout thanking the player and telling them to go and leave her to her writing

hemomancy.trade.tier.confidant.about: the name of the confidant rapport tier with a trading NPC

hemomancy.trade.tier.known.about: the name of the known rapport tier with a trading NPC

hemomancy.trade.tier.stranger.about: the name of the stranger rapport tier with a trading NPC

hemomancy.trade.tier.trusted.about: the name of the trusted rapport tier with a trading NPC

hemomancy.trade.ui.act.spectacle.about: a label for paying a trade with a performance

hemomancy.trade.ui.act.spectacle.hint.about: a hint explaining that a pavilion performance held to the end pays for one trade

hemomancy.trade.ui.act_confirm.about: a confirmation that the trade was paid with a performance the player watched through

hemomancy.trade.ui.blood.about: a blood price in millibuckets, with the amount filled in

hemomancy.trade.ui.carried.enough.about: a short status that the player carries enough of the required items

hemomancy.trade.ui.carried.some.about: a short status that the player carries some but not enough of the required items

hemomancy.trade.ui.custom.about: a label saying the item is their house's custom, given as a gift

hemomancy.trade.ui.custom_confirm.about: a confirmation that the item was given from the pack as the custom asks

hemomancy.trade.ui.fine_pays.about: a short label introducing what fine work pays instead

hemomancy.trade.ui.give_count.about: a count and item name for an item the player gives, with count and name filled in

hemomancy.trade.ui.rapport.about: a label showing the rapport tier, with the tier name filled in

hemomancy.trade.ui.restocks_in.about: a label saying the trade restocks in a number of days, with the day count filled in

hemomancy.trade.ui.restocks_one.about: a label saying the trade restocks tomorrow

hemomancy.trade.ui.uses_left.about: a label giving how many uses of the trade are left, with the count filled in

hemomancy.trade.zealot.amethyst.line.about: the Zealot asking for three amethyst shards for one Draught of Still Waters, poured only for their own, and asking if the player is theirs yet

hemomancy.trade.zealot.amethyst.title.about: a short title for the Zealot's amethyst trade card

hemomancy.trade.zealot.clean_copper.line.about: the Zealot offering two vials of Lethean Dew for six copper ingots and demanding to know plainly why the player wants dew

hemomancy.trade.zealot.clean_copper.titl.about: a short title for the Zealot's clean copper trade card

hemomancy.trade.zealot.refuse_harbinger.about: the Zealot refusing to trade with someone the blood still feeds and asking why they don't ask for a cure instead

hemomancy.trade.zealot.stained.about: the Zealot demanding where the player got a blood-work item and refusing to take it into the church

hemomancy.trade.zealot.thanks.about: the Zealot accepting a trade and telling the player to use it for healing, not curiosity

hemomancy.unstained.already_enlightened.about: a system message that the player has already achieved Enlightenment

hemomancy.unstained.clarity_progress.about: a system message showing the player's clarity progress out of 100, with the current value filled in

hemomancy.unstained.enlightened.about: a system message that the player has achieved Enlightenment and is Unstained

hemomancy.unstained.manipulation_blocked.about: a system message that the player's purified blood refuses to obey a manipulation

hemomancy.unstained.manipulation_weakene.about: a system message that the player's purifying blood resists the manipulation

hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.clarity.line1.about: the Votary Wayfarer observing that the clear stillness around the player makes their samples settle, and that they don't think they imagine it

hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.clarity.line2.about: the Votary Wayfarer admitting the effect is both unnerving and useful and they are still learning to tell the two apart

hemomancy.voyager.clarity.line1.about: the Harbinger Voyager remarking that the Lady's clarity is a hard lantern in deep water

hemomancy.voyager.clarity.line2.about: the Voyager advising a colleague to use clarity kindly because some memories below are wounds, not confessions to pry at

hemomancy.zealot.absolved.line1.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, telling an Absolved player that most of the stain has gone quiet and that the silence can feel like grief

hemomancy.zealot.absolved.line2.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, saying that once fully purified, clarity will ask whether the player wants peace or sight, and asking what they would answer today

hemomancy.zealot.already_on_path.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, telling a player already on the path of purification to keep working at the podium until the stain lifts, and asking why they came to the Zealot

hemomancy.zealot.altar_info.line1.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, asking what the player will lay on the Altar, and listing that it takes only Tears of Silthmere, Lethean Poppy Wreaths, Silver Chalices, Pallid Icons and Lethean Brew

hemomancy.zealot.altar_info.line2.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, explaining that tears, wreaths, chalices and icons count once each, while Lethean Brew gives less each time and stops counting after five offerings

hemomancy.zealot.annetta_map.line1.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, saying Annetta was one of theirs, frightened and trying to be useful before the screaming and the sealed door

hemomancy.zealot.annetta_map.line2.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, giving the player a map to the church where Annetta hid, which still stands, and urging them to carry mercy there with both hands

hemomancy.zealot.bloodline_founded.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, flatly refusing a player who founded a bloodline, explaining their blood runs in others so Unstained rites cannot reach it while the covenant stands, and ordering them to leave before Guardians must answer

hemomancy.zealot.clarity_phase.line1.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, telling the player their halo has opened behind them and asking if they feel how little the old hunger matters now

hemomancy.zealot.clarity_phase.line2.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, explaining verdigris is the color copper turns once it has endured, wryly calling it a grand name for weathered metal, and saying following it brings focus

hemomancy.zealot.clarity_rite_info.line1.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, explaining Clarity Ascension is where the player pledges themselves, since being cleansed alone does not make one Unstained, and asking if they are ready to mean it

hemomancy.zealot.clarity_rite_info.line2.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, stating the requirements: first restore the mortal baseline or fulfill all five vows, then offer Consecrated Copper at the Podium and speak the rite

hemomancy.zealot.cleansing.line1.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, telling a Cleansing player they reached the hard middle where the stain fights hardest once named, and asking whether they have named it or only treated it

hemomancy.zealot.cleansing.line2.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, directing the player to the Altar of Cleansing, saying Our Lady's tears wash a wound rather than flatter it

hemomancy.zealot.craft_hemolytic.line1.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, explaining hemolytic solution starts with Lethean Dew and Ghost Pipe and no crimson catalyst, and asking whether the player wants to make it or only asked

hemomancy.zealot.craft_hemolytic.line2.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, telling the player to take finished solution to the Podium to suppress the infection, with Lethean Baptism coming after when ready

hemomancy.zealot.craft_hemolytic.line3.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, warning that the first treatment hurts as the old current is cut off, that the pain proves nothing about devotion, and not to wear it like a medal

hemomancy.zealot.enlightened.line1.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, telling an Enlightened player there is nothing left to teach, and that the still water took their reflection and gave back something clearer

hemomancy.zealot.enlightened.line2.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, asking if the player remembers why they were given mercy, warning that forgetting it makes mercy cast a shadow, and bidding them go gently

hemomancy.zealot.item_hint.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, asking what the player is carrying and why, and offering to say what the Church makes of it

hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.altar_of_c.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, telling the player they will need the Altar later for blessings and offerings, since it is for those already on the path, and asking if they are on it
the Zealot, a patient interrogator, explaining to first suppress the infection at the Podium, Lethean Baptism admits to Purity, and only then do offerings come to the Altar

hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.bone_meal..about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, describing bone meal as ground bones with nothing holy in the sack, yet death turned around to feed things, and Our Lady being patient with that return
the Zealot, a patient interrogator, saying it is what they think of when thinking of purification, corruption returning to the world as something that can grow, and asking if the player can bear that

hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.cleansed_b.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, explaining a cleansed blood crystal shard has had its sanguine resonance neutralized by Unstained rites, leaving inert crystal to build and craft with
the Zealot, a patient interrogator, saying the cleansing can't be undone, the shard cannot return to sanguine energy, which is what they want, and asking if the player hoped otherwise

hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.consecrate.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, describing Consecrated Copper as copper that came through its change and was readied for deeper Unstained work
the Zealot, a patient interrogator, asking how full the player's Purity is, and saying once full they bring the copper to the Podium to prepare Clarity before the Rite of Clarity Ascension

hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.copper_ing.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, describing raw copper as the starting metal before the blessing, not yet marked by Our Lady, waiting as metal waits
the Zealot, a patient interrogator, explaining consecration is Retort work with hemolytic solution as catalyst, simple but not hurried, and asking why the player wants the copper blessed

hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.draught_of.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, explaining the Draught of Still Waters is distilled cold from white humor and Lethean Dew, clears Blood Loss and holds a Silver Ward for three minutes
the Zealot, a patient interrogator, saying it is field medicine, not a milestone, proves nothing to Our Lady, and asking if the player is hurt or only thirsty

hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.hallowed_r.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, explaining Hallowed Residuum is a Saint's own blood concentrated, drawn peacefully by a Harbinger of matching temper while anyone else wakes the Saint to be tested
the Zealot, a patient interrogator, noting it shows the same danger either way, blood-power outlasting the wisdom behind it, and asking why the player carries it

hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.hemolytic_.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, explaining hemolytic solution at the Unstained Podium suppresses active infection, only preparing the body, while the Rite makes a practitioner Unstained
the Zealot, a patient interrogator, telling the player that once infection is suppressed they perform the Rite of Lethean Baptism, where Purity starts
the Zealot, a patient interrogator, explaining that hemolytic solution at the Podium quiets the blood-memory enough for a candidate to survive Baptism
the Zealot, a patient interrogator, calling it preparation only: treatment begins at Baptism and the pledge waits for Clarity Ascension

hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.lethean.li.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, explaining Lethean Dew is the Lethean Poppy distilled at the Pallid Retort, becomes Pale Distillate with a fresh poppy, and distills again into Lethean Brew
the Zealot, a patient interrogator, telling the player to use each form where the rite calls for it, letting poetry guide the hand if it helps but following the recipe

hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.lethean_po.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, saying Our Lady marked the Lethean Poppy as her own, it grows where water has gone still and taint recedes, so where one grows purification has begun

the Zealot, a patient interrogator, telling the player to take heads for dew and distillate, that a whole poppy woven into a wreath is an Altar offering, to leave enough standing, and asking how many they left
the Zealot, a patient interrogator, describing a wreath of Lethean Poppies as patient labor offered without bargaining with blood
the Zealot, a patient interrogator, saying the Altar takes it as a modest Purity offering and the exact amount is found in the progress record, not prayer

hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.liber_imma.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, explaining the Liber Immaculatus is the guide they work from, its First Steps laying out the sequence: Podium, Cleansed Stone, then Baptism
the Zealot, a patient interrogator, telling the player to keep it, since later pages cover Purity, Clarity and the defensive Still Arts, and not to skip to the parts about power

hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.lily_of_th.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, describing Lily of the Valley as growing in still shady places Our Lady favors, with no formal Altar rite, yet turning up near places of cleansing
the Zealot, a patient interrogator, saying older texts call it a sign the ground is recovering, they never made a rite of it and maybe should, or maybe it just likes shade

hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.milk_bucke.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, describing milk as the old folk remedy for poison, the first reach for cleansing from inside, with some truth in it even though the Altar works another way

the Zealot, a patient interrogator, saying the path is that same reaching but deeper, milk draws out the surface while hemolytic solution and the Altar reach the blood-matrix, and asking which the player is after

hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.minecraft_.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, calling the plain material good for patient work, saying purification is built from such things more often than miracles
the Zealot, a patient interrogator, telling the player to use it where the rite asks, asking if they hoped for something grander, and not to think less of a simple offering

hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.pale_disti.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, explaining Pale Distillate is Lethean Dew worked with a whole poppy, or Ghost Pipe through the Retort, everything the poppy offers pressed small
the Zealot, a patient interrogator, saying distilling it again yields the Lethean Brew the Altar takes, advising the player to plan their harvest, and asking if they mean to

hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.pale_humor.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, explaining a Pale Humor Flask holds purified White Humor, lymph cleared of hematic corruption, not to be mistaken for holy blood
the Zealot, a patient interrogator, telling the player to keep it sealed for preservation and cleansing work, and asking what they wanted it for

hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.pale_silve.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, explaining Pale Silver is what Consecrated Copper becomes at the next stage, refined in the Pallid Retort with white humor, with no mine yielding any
the Zealot, a patient interrogator, observing it earned its stillness the way the Unstained earn theirs

hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.pallid_ico.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, explaining this is a consecrated copy of the Pallid Icon, the original being the river relic, the copies keeping its faceless still-water gesture with patience underneath
the Zealot, a patient interrogator, saying to carry, wear or set it down, that some feel more receptive near the Altar, that Our Lady notices sincerity not display, and asking which this is

hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.pallid_inf.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, describing Pallid Infusion as a battlefield restorative distilled from Ghost Pipe and White Humor

the Zealot, a patient interrogator, explaining it clears Blood Loss and gives short regeneration but brings no Clarity, which comes from Consecrated Copper at the Podium and the Rite of Clarity Ascension

hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.purificati.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, identifying the item as Unstained rite equipment, practical vessels and fittings for controlled purification work
the Zealot, a patient interrogator, telling the player to use it carefully at consecrated stations, since purification takes discipline and fervor burns out, and asking which they brought

hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.self_refle.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, explaining the Self-Reflection Mirror opens the player's Unstained progress record of purity, clarity and place on the path, and every practitioner should keep one
the Zealot, a patient interrogator, saying it shows what one is, Our Lady gives the reading plainly, and the deciding is left to the player

hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.silver_cha.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, explaining the Silver Chalice is for Clarity work once the second path has opened, and asking if it has
the Zealot, a patient interrogator, telling the player to offer it when the rite and progress call for it, the mirror keeping the number and the Church the meaning

hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.snow_block.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, musing that snow is water that chose to stay where it fell and deep snow holds a little of Our Lady, a cold that asks nothing and waits
the Zealot, a patient interrogator, saying the path leads toward a fullness that can stay still, which deep snow resembles, though it is also just cold, and practice will make it clear

hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.sugar.line.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, musing that sugar is what remains after refining, the sweetness left once raw stuff is boiled to its character, and that clarity can feel like that
the Zealot, a patient interrogator, admitting the comparison ends there because it is sugar, and that farther along the path things grow simpler and more fully themselves

hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.tears_of_s.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, describing Tears of Silthmere as a crafted distillation named for Silthmere, one of Our Lady's liturgical titles
the Zealot, a patient interrogator, saying their potency comes from disciplined preparation and consecration, asking if the player thought it was grief, and denying mortal grief or wild water matter

hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.unknown.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, dismissing an unrelated item as having no use on the path and asking why the player thought it would

hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.unstained_.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, explaining Unstained armor is pale silver alloy throughout, resists blood-corruption on contact and can be worn without disturbing purification once well along the path
the Zealot, a patient interrogator, saying the full set carries a blessing of Our Lady's protection gathering in her metal, that wearing it declares commitment, and asking if the player has committed

hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.water_buck.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, saying water is Our Lady's element: still water covers the deep, carries off what is shed, remembers what it touches, and she lives in water that waits until it decides to move

the Zealot, a patient interrogator, telling the player to carry it with intention, since sincerely brought still water is a gesture the Altar won't count for them, and Our Lady also sees buckets carried for show

hemomancy.zealot.no_blood.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, telling a player with no mark of the blood arts to explain why they come, and offering that they can take five vows of clean service if they want the Church anyway

hemomancy.zealot.plea.degree0.line2.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, telling a Degree 0 player the infection has only just wounded them, apologizing, and saying it can still be treated

hemomancy.zealot.plea.degree1.line2.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, telling a Degree 1 player the first rite has marked them, the infection is fresh so give it time before calling it a calling, and asking what made them take the rite

hemomancy.zealot.plea.degree2.line2.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, addressing a Degree 2 Votary, noting they have started calling the stain a covenant, asking who taught them that word, and saying it hasn't claimed all of them

hemomancy.zealot.plea.degree3.line2.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, addressing a Degree 3 Initiate of the Incarnadine Fane, asking whether they want healing or another power, and saying the Church fears curiosity dressed up as repentance

hemomancy.zealot.plea.degree4.line2.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, addressing a Degree 4 Adept, noting the blood has given craft, companions and appetite, and demanding to know if they came for a cure or conquest

hemomancy.zealot.plea.degree5.line2.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, addressing a Degree 5 Illuminatus whom the Crimson Lodge has looked back at through their veins, asking why they come now and admitting trust won't come easily

hemomancy.zealot.plea.degree6.line2.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, telling a deep-Degree player with no bloodline of their own that the cure is open though slow, and asking why they come so late

hemomancy.zealot.plea.line1.about: narration of the Zealot regarding the player with silver eyes

hemomancy.zealot.plea.line3.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, telling the player it is not too late and that hemolytic rites can cleanse what the Hematic Order corrupted

hemomancy.zealot.plea.line4.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, telling the player to bring hemolytic solution to the podium and begin the Unstained path, leaving the crimson veil behind before it consumes them

hemomancy.zealot.silver_ward_info.line1.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, explaining Silver Ward carries further the defense Verdigris began, so that with Clarity a warning from outside becomes a boundary the blood's current has trouble crossing

hemomancy.zealot.silver_ward_info.line2.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, explaining Verdigris Aura learned to recognize infection in Purity while Clarity teaches Silver Ward to refuse its orders, and asking if the player can tell when it is giving them

hemomancy.zealot.tainted.line1.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, telling a Tainted player the first pallor is in them, asking if the relief they feel is good, and saying it is only the start

hemomancy.zealot.tainted.line2.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, telling the player their Verdigris Aura will answer more readily as the first boundary their blood learns to respect

hemomancy.zealot.take_vows.prompt.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, asking if the player will serve the Church until all five vows are done, and calling them work with no ceremony to hide behind

hemomancy.zealot.verdigris_info.line1.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, explaining Virid Salis and verdigris are corruption spent and turned into a ward, which they work with but do not decorate with

hemomancy.zealot.verdigris_info.line2.about: the Zealot, a patient interrogator, telling the player to lay them where blood gathers, since the line won't clear what is already there but lets none pass

message.hemomancy.drudge_entity.memory_i.about: a message that a memory was installed in a Drudge, with the memory's name filled in

message.hemomancy.drudge_entity.memory_r.about: a message that a memory was retrieved from a Drudge

message.hemomancy.drudge_entity.mode_mem.about: a status line showing a Drudge's mode, installed memory and blood charge in millilitres, with each value filled in

message.hemomancy.drudge_entity.no_match.about: a message that no matching memory item was found

message.hemomancy.drudge_entity.no_memor.about: a message that no memory is installed in the Drudge

message.hemomancy.drudge_entity.rogue_dr.about: a short name label for a rogue Drudge
